LHX.sentence: L3Harris dropped about 10% today, but that's because their profit margins came in thinner than usual this quarter — the actual defense business and its steady government contracts haven't changed.

ASML.sentence: ASML had a nice week higher, which is business as usual for the only company on earth that makes the machines needed to print the most advanced computer chips.

LIN.sentence: Linde barely moved — industrial gas demand is steady and they nudge prices up a little each quarter, which is pretty much the whole quiet story here.

MSFT.sentence: Microsoft jumped sharply this week on continued excitement about its AI and cloud business, though it's still below where it traded at its peak.

TMO.sentence: Thermo Fisher was basically flat, but funding is thawing for the biotech labs that buy its equipment, so more orders are likely coming down the road.

ENB.sentence: Enbridge is quiet as ever — the pipelines collect their tolls reliably, though the stock has gotten a touch pricey for what it pays out.

NOW.sentence: ServiceNow has fallen a long way from its high, but big companies and government agencies keep signing on for its workflow and AI-assistant tools, so the business itself is still solid.

GLNCY.sentence: Glencore ticked up as copper prices firmed, and even though its profits are in a slump right now, that low point in the cycle is often when miners like this are worth accumulating.

IBIT.sentence: Bitcoin edged up a bit but is still well below where it was earlier in the year — a quieter, cooler stretch after its big run.

KOF.sentence: The Latin American Coca-Cola bottler had a calm week, helped by a stable Mexican peso, which matters since most of its sales are in that currency.

PBR.A.sentence: Petrobras is having a good stretch — oil prices are comfortably high enough to keep its very large dividend flowing, though those fat profits reflect a strong oil market that won't last forever.

AMKBY.sentence: No data came through for Maersk, the container shipping company, today — nothing to report.

MA.sentence: Mastercard rose a bit and is now unusually cheap relative to its twin Visa — people keep tapping their cards worldwide, and it collects a tiny toll each time.

ISRG.sentence: The da Vinci surgical robot maker is down a lot from its high and now looks genuinely cheap for a business this strong, with hospitals still doing more and more procedures on its machines.
